mapper.sql: id, username, nickname, avatar, password_hash, status, invite_code, register_ip, created_at, last_login_at
mapper.select: select u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.password_hash, u.status, u.invite_code, u.register_ip, u.created_at, u.last_login_at from app_user u inner join app_user_identity i on i.user_id = u.id where i.type = #{type} and i.identifier = #{identifier} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into app_user (username, nickname, avatar, password_hash, status, invite_code, register_ip) values (#{username}, #{nickname}, #{avatar,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{passwordHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{inviteCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{registerIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: update app_user set last_login_at = now() where id = #{id}
